_how_to_use_this_file: Two prizes cannot be read off a scoreboard, so they are typed in here.
Add one object to 'entries' when a prize is triggered, then commit.
type    must be exactly 'The Pink Slip' or 'QB Down'.
team    the three-letter abbreviation, for example NYJ, KC, GB, LV.
week    the week it happened, a whole number from 1 to 18.
status  'confirmed' pays it. 'proposed' records it without paying.
detail  one short sentence. It shows on the page under the prize.
The build refuses to run if anything here is wrong, and says what.
Example of a finished entry, to copy into the empty list below:
{ "type": "The Pink Slip", "team": "NYJ", "week": 6, "status": "confirmed", "detail": "Head coach dismissed on the Monday after Week 6" }
